skill.name: learn
skill.description: Extract and persist project-specific insights from the current conversation to a local knowledge base.
skill.summary: Captures project lessons from a conversation and stores them for future AI coding sessions.
skill.author: 0xrdan

security_audit.summary: The static backtick and reconnaissance detections are false positives from markdown formatting, inline file names, and example text in SKILL.md. I found no prompt injection or external command execution. The main risk is intentional persistence of conversation-derived knowledge without explicit redaction guidance.

remediation.issue: Conversation insights may include sensitive information.
remediation.suggestion: Add instructions to omit secrets, credentials, customer data, and private identifiers before writing knowledge entries.

remediation.issue: Persistent file writes are central to the skill but trust boundaries are implicit.
remediation.suggestion: State that writes must stay within knowledge/learnings and knowledge/state.json unless the user approves another path.

remediation.issue: Deep mode expands analysis scope through a separate agent context.
remediation.suggestion: Clarify that deep mode should inspect only the local project and should not use network access or external commands.

semantic_findings.title: Conversation Data Persistence Without Redaction Guidance
semantic_findings.description: The skill extracts insights from the current conversation and appends them to persistent knowledge files. Without explicit redaction guidance, sensitive project, customer, or credential details could be retained in the repository.

content.value_statement: Teams lose project-specific lessons after chat sessions end. This skill extracts patterns, quirks, and decisions into a persistent knowledge base.
actual_capabilities: Extracts project patterns, quirks, and decisions from the current conversation.
Supports quick extraction and a deeper analysis mode using an Explore agent context.
Appends formatted entries to patterns, quirks, and decisions knowledge files.
Updates knowledge metadata, including entry counts, timestamps, and extraction state.
Checks existing knowledge entries to avoid duplicate lessons.
Reports a short summary of what was learned and current knowledge totals.
limitations: It only extracts insights from the current conversation context.
It assumes the project uses the expected knowledge directory and state file structure.
It does not include explicit secret redaction rules.
Confidence labels are model judgments and should be reviewed for important workflows.

use_cases.title: Preserve Debugging Lessons
use_cases.description: Capture a root cause, fix, and workaround after a complex debugging session.

use_cases.title: Record Architecture Decisions
use_cases.description: Store the context and rationale behind implementation choices for future project work.

use_cases.title: Maintain Project Memory
use_cases.description: Build a reusable knowledge base that survives context resets and handoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Save a Simple Lesson
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner use after a short session.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use learn to save the most important project-specific lesson from this conversation.

prompt_templates.title: Capture a Debugging Quirk
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate use after diagnosing unusual behavior.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use learn to document the quirk we discovered, including where it appears and the recommended workaround.

prompt_templates.title: Record a Decision
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced use after choosing an approach.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use learn to record the decision we made, the alternatives considered, and the rationale for the final choice.

prompt_templates.title: Run Deep Extraction
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced use after a long debugging or design session.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use learn with deep analysis to find related project patterns, validate them against the codebase, and update the knowledge base.

output_examples.input: After fixing an authentication issue, capture the lesson for future sessions.
output_examples.output: The skill records a quirk about token handling, adds a workaround, updates metadata, and reports the new knowledge totals.

output_examples.input: After selecting a new state management approach, preserve the rationale.
output_examples.output: The skill adds a decision entry with context, choice, rationale, confidence, and a concise summary for the user.

output_examples.input: After a long debugging session, identify reusable project patterns.
output_examples.output: The skill reviews the conversation, checks existing knowledge, adds non-duplicate patterns, and updates extraction state.

best_practices: Review generated knowledge entries before committing them to the repository.
Remove secrets and private details from the conversation before running the skill.
Use deep analysis after major debugging sessions or architecture decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not store generic programming advice that is not specific to the project.
Do not run the skill on conversations that contain unredacted secrets or private customer data.
Do not let low-confidence entries drive routing or design decisions without review.

faq.question: What does this skill save?
faq.answer: It saves project-specific patterns, quirks, and decisions found in the current conversation.

faq.question: Where does it write information?
faq.answer: It writes formatted entries under the knowledge learnings files and updates the knowledge state file.

faq.question: What does deep mode add?
faq.answer: Deep mode uses a separate Explore agent context to analyze related code and validate discoveries.

faq.question: Does it protect secrets automatically?
faq.answer: No. Users should remove credentials, customer data, and private identifiers before running it.

faq.question: Does it avoid duplicate entries?
faq.answer: Yes. The instructions tell the assistant to read existing entries and skip similar insights.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible skill workflows.
